items.title: Javonte Williams: Eclipses century mark in win
items.description:
Williams rushed 20 times for 101 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for 23 yards in the Cowboys' 27-23 win over the Colts on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Puka Nacua: Will have MRI on knee Monday
items.description:
Nacua suffered a knee injury during Sunday's 20-13 win at Washington and will undergo an MRI on Monday to determine its extent, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: CeeDee Lamb: Standout numbers again in win
items.description:
Lamb brought in 10 of 16 targets for 195 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 27-23 win over the Colts on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyren Williams: Bottled up by Commanders
items.description:
Williams carried the ball 15 times for 45 yards and caught three of four targets for 16 yards in Sunday's 20-13 win over Washington.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kenneth Walker: Three total TDs in win
items.description:
Walker rushed 18 times for 102 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 41 yards and two more scores in the Chiefs' 35-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.
